summary: Cleveland Metropolitan School District supports maintaining E-Rate funding for MIBS as essential for school operations The comment emphasizes the critical role of broadband connectivity in modern education, highlighting the importance of E-Rate for student learning and cybersecurity. It argues against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, citing the cost savings and the need for reliable broadband infrastructure to support various educational technologies and services. The comment supports maintaining MIBS funding under E-Rate, citing cost savings and budgetary impacts on educational programs. The school district urges the FCC to preserve MIBS support for Category Two services to ensure educational access and operational resilience.
